The three evaluation criteria are as follows: (1) Cross-turn reasoning (CR): Full reasoning (5 points): the model accurately integrates information from multiple dialogue turns... (2) Information Update (IU): Complete Update (5 points): the model accurately and promptly updates new factual information... (3) Memory Recall (MR): Accurate Recall (5 points): the model accurately recalls key information (e.g., user preferences, previous conversation details)...
